{payload}

confirm_discovered.title: Pair {name}
confirm_discovered.description:
OldPhoneKiosk found a nearby phone/tablet that is waiting for Home Assistant.

Device: **{name}**
Model: **{model}**
iOS: **{ios}**
App: **{app_version}**
Address: **{host}**

Submit to confirm this is the device and send it a one-time pairing claim. No code entry or QR scan is required.

error.waiting_for_phone: Waiting for the phone/tablet to scan the QR and connect.
error.not_connected: The claim was used, but the phone/tablet is not connected yet.
error.cannot_connect: Home Assistant could not reach the discovered phone/tablet. Keep the app open on the same local network and try again.

abort.invalid_discovery: The discovered OldPhoneKiosk advertisement was incomplete.
abort.pairing_sent: Pairing was sent to the discovered phone/tablet. It should appear as a device when it connects.
